description: GRC InitDisk: Command-line USB formatter that can create a FAT-formatted and optionally FreeDOS-bootable drive.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.
Destructive storage utility: it reformats the USB drive you select and can erase all data on it. Run only after checking the selected device.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for InitDisk.' }
